name: media-archiver-userscript
description: Build and validation tooling for the modular Media Archiver product.

scripts.build: npm run build:userscript && npm run build:extension:chromium && npm run build:extension:firefox
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/contracts.test.mjs tests/shared-services.test.mjs tests/runtime-bridge.test.mjs tests/library-workflow.test.mjs tests/pinterest-adapter.test.mjs tests/reddit-comments.test.mjs
scripts.test:builds: npm run build:extension:chromium && npm run build:extension:firefox && npm run check:extension:chromium && npm run check:extension:firefox && npm run check:reproducible
scripts.test: npm run build:userscript && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:invariants && npm run check:unsupported && npm run test:baseline && npm run test:unit && npm run test:builds
